title: Method of Test for Detection and Determination of Antioxidant Additives in Insulating Oils
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13631) covers Method of Test for Detection and Determination of Antioxidant Additives in Insulating Oils. This Indian Standard was adopted by the the Fluids for Electrotechnical Applications Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. Test for detection and determination of antioxidant additives in insulating oils was part of the specification, IS 335 on new mineral insulating oils. With the advancement of technology and experience gained, this test method has been developed taking into account various types of inhibitors possible in liquids. Since this method can also be used to detect inhibitors in used oil also, therefore it was decided to bring out separate standard on this subject. In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the following publications: lEC Pub 666 ( 1979 ) Detection and determination of specified antioxidant additives in insulating oils, issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission ( lEC ). marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
